---
title: "Before you begin"
---

## What you need

You need:

1. an MCPS DNAnexus account;
2. access to the DNAnexus training project; and
3. an assigned participant workspace.

No command-line knowledge is required for this tutorial.

## The most important idea

Think of your DNAnexus project and your JupyterLab session as two different things:

- **DNAnexus project:** persistent storage for approved data, notebooks and saved outputs.
- **JupyterLab:** temporary computing resources used to run R and perform your analysis.

Your JupyterLab environment can be stopped and recreated. Your saved **`[DX]` notebook** remains in the project.

::: {.callout-tip}
## A useful rule

**Save your notebook regularly, and terminate JupyterLab when you are finished.**
:::
